estimands.outcome: Cardiovascular death or first heart-failure hospitalisation (2-component composite)
estimands.missing_data_model: time-to-first-event, all randomised, censored at last contact (no imputation)

harmonisation_rule.harmonised_endpoint: CV death or first HF hospitalisation (2-component). EMPEROR trials do NOT count urgent HF visits; DAPA-HF and DELIVER do. The 2-component is the endpoint ALL FOUR report; DELIVER publishes its 2-component HR 0.80 (0.71-0.91), 475 vs 577, so no trial is dropped for a definition mismatch.
harmonisation_rule.source: trial primary publications + Vaduganathan 2022 pooled analysis

eligibility.population: adults with chronic heart failure across the ejection-fraction spectrum

disclosure_clause.text: AUTHORED 2026-09-06, RETROSPECTIVE: written after the four trials completed and after the correct k=4 pool (HR 0.774) and Vaduganathan's five-trial benchmark 0.77 (0.72-0.82) were known. Methods chosen on methodological grounds; BOTH REML/Wald and HKSJ intervals reported. Labelled retrospective choice, not pre-specification.

governance.supersedes_why: v1.1 contradicts itself (s8 DL+HKSJ vs Appendix A fixed-effect at k=2) and its benchmark line is factually wrong (cites Vaduganathan as DELIVER+DAPA-HF=0.77 k=2; the real two-trial pairing is DELIVER+EMPEROR-Preserved=0.80, and 0.77 is the five-trial 0.77 0.72-0.82).
